reviews.title: Account locked after months of use
reviews.text:
After accepting payments for over two months, I suddenly was unable to accept card payments at my last event. I called PayPal and was told my account had been restricted until I detailed what I sold in about 10 transactions, as well as describe my business - something that was already required when setting up my account. 

My wife had her Square reader with her at my last event, which flawlessly took all my payments for the day. Had it not been for her having her own business as well, I would’ve lost about $250 in sales this past week. 

After being told my issues would be resolved in 24-48 hours, I am still unable to take payments this weekend. I am done with these people.

DO NOT waste your time, effort, patience, or money with PayPal and Zettle. Other processors cost more per transaction, but at least I know from personal experience already that they won’t suddenly stop working when I need them.

Update: Their screens for pulling reports for taxes are also an absolute nightmare. Square isn’t too much better, but this was not a great experience either. I urge you to try anyone else.

reviews.title: Total Lack of Trust and Technical Failure - Stay Away!
reviews.text: I’ve been using PayPal Zettle for my physical repair shop, and it has become a nightmare. They are currently holding $1,300 of my revenue, demanding tracking numbers for services provided in person. It’s absurd to ask for shipping proof for a screen repair done at a counter. > To make matters worse, their payment processing is unreliable. About 30% of my customers’ cards are declined by their banks when using the Zettle terminal, flagged as ‘suspicious.’ Every time this happens, I have to open my Square app, and the transaction goes through perfectly on the first try. > They demand impossible ‘proof of purchase’ for individual screws or bulk parts bought years ago just to fix a phone. They provide zero human support for brick-and-mortar businesses. They let you keep receiving money but block your withdrawals, effectively holding your business hostage. Save yourself the stress: Go with Square or Clover from day one.

reviews.title: Awful tax management
reviews.text:
I can’t stop hating zettle after having a wonderful experience with PayPal Here! 
It’s just awful! I have a hundred of items and in order to sell them in different places i have to manually change tax rate on every single item I have! There is just no way to change it all at once! You can create a new product with a new tax but there is no way to just switch between taxes, like it was on PP Here. Even though they have a “default tax rate” option, it doesn’t mean that it will apply to all your existing listings, it just means that a new product will have it. And only this one issue makes all experience with zettle below 1 star. Annoying! Their software  developers are unprofessional! If you have option to use another card reader software, don’t chose this one, you will suffer!
By the way, I contacted their support, they suggested one very complicated method to go around, which I wasn’t successful to reproduce, and they said that there is not a very big chance that they will change anything or even point to the issue to the right people. I will be leaving my detailed reviews until right people notice the problem.
